faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Have questions? We have answers. If you don't see what you're looking for, reach out to our team.
faq.q1: What types of processes can you automate?
faq.a1: We automate a wide range of business processes including data entry, email workflows, CRM updates, invoice processing, employee onboarding, report generation, and cross-platform integrations. If it's repetitive and rule-based, we can likely automate it.
faq.q2: How long does a typical implementation take?
faq.a2: Most projects go from discovery to launch in 2-6 weeks depending on complexity. Simple automations can be live within days, while comprehensive BI solutions may take 4-8 weeks.
faq.q3: Do you integrate with our existing tools?
faq.a3: Yes. We work with all major platforms including Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zapier, Make, custom APIs, and hundreds more.
faq.a4: Every plan includes ongoing monitoring and support. We proactively identify issues, optimize performance, and scale your solutions as your business grows.
faq.q5: Can I see a demo before committing?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We offer a free consultation and demo. We'll assess your needs and show you exactly what we can build, with no obligation.
